title: Proposed tests and outcome register
text:
recommendation_id,driver_ids,target,actor,proposal,baseline_comparator,outcome,horizon,feasibility_cost_limit,decision_rule,evidence_ids,status
"R01","D01;D02;D07","Separately sampled Indian and Pakistani outlets and defined replacement-food categories","Proposed research lead with participating retailers; none appointed","Audit comparable portions, actual transaction/list prices, stock availability and category sales; add income-group purchase measurement only if supported by an approved design.","Same outlet/time, defined conventional and other relevant food alternatives; record pack size, preparation, promotion and serving basis.","Observed price per declared comparable serving; availability; actual paid purchases. No demand inference from price/listing alone.","Proposed repeated observations over 8–12 weeks; scheduling and sample depend on feasibility.","Confirm outlet access, usable transaction data, staff time and data permissions before committing; no budget is established.","Pre-specify coverage and comparability; if sales cannot be verified publish a bounded price/availability audit, not a national market total.","fao_sofi_2025;imf_weo_2026_10;altprotein_jobs_vacancy_2023_2025","author_proposal_pending_review"
"R02","D02;D03;D04","A defined product, meal and recruited population in each country separately","Proposed local study team and qualified partners; none appointed","Test meal fit and price conditions; separate blinded sensory choice, labelled intention, paid first purchase and unsubsidized repeat purchase.","Matched conventional or relevant familiar meal; clearly recorded subsidy and information conditions; comparator selected before outcomes are observed.","Paid first purchase and repeat purchase after incentives end; preparation acceptability; separately measured conventional-food displacement if included.","Proposed 8–12-week follow-up after initial trial, subject to design feasibility.","Confirm product availability, lawful sale, sampling/access and participant protections; no national representativeness claim or cost commitment.","Set primary outcome and decision threshold before recruitment; no threshold asserted from current evidence.","india_cultural_bryant_2019;fao_sofi_2025","author_proposal_pending_review"
"R03","D05;D06","One specified fermentation ingredient/product/process and intended jurisdiction","Proposed product owner with qualified food-regulatory and halal advisers; none engaged","Prepare ingredient/process and intended-use dossier; request applicable certification and food-authorization requirements separately.","Existing product dossier and written applicable requirements; no assumption that a ruling on another technology or country transfers.","Documented requirements, open questions and product-specific decisions; not a blanket halal label.","Before any proposed pilot sale; duration depends on competent bodies, not scheduled here.","Confirm access to ingredient/process details and qualified review; no legal or certification outcome promised.","Do not treat unresolved assurance or authorization as approval; choose the next feasible research step from the actual response.","pakistan_cultural_halal_act_2016;proxy_specification_20261022","author_proposal_pending_review"
"R04","D07","One Indian employer-nominated technical bottleneck in a specified process","Proposed employer and training/research partner; none committed","Validate the bottleneck and trial a focused technical/training intervention.","Recorded pre-intervention performance and a credible contemporaneous or staged comparator; do not use vacancy counts as the baseline skill gap.","Independently checked process quality, consistency, throughput and unit cost; separate measured employment/training outcomes.","Proposed baseline plus 3–6-month pilot, subject to employer and facility feasibility.","Confirm staff, facilities, process data, evaluation and cost ceiling before procurement or training launch.","Pre-agree improvement and cost criteria after baseline; current evidence does not establish expected returns.","gfi_india_talent_landscape","author_proposal_pending_review"
"R05","D07","A proposed Pakistani ingredient-application pilot at a verified facility","Proposed local facility and research partner; none verified or appointed","First assess facilities, staff, inputs, product need and distribution access; proceed to a bounded process trial only if feasible.","Verified current capability and non-intervention process; directory presence is not proof of capability.","Feasibility record; if a trial proceeds, validated product functionality, batch consistency and cost.","Feasibility stage first; any subsequent 3–6-month trial is a design proposal, not a scheduled programme.","No equipment or programme commitment before site/staff/data access and budget are confirmed.","Stop or redesign if capability/data requirements are not met; report the gap without inferring national absence.","altprotein_jobs_company_directory_2024;altprotein_jobs_vacancy_2023_2025;proxy_specification_20261022","author_proposal_pending_review"
"R06","D07;D08","One feasible AI-assisted technical application and its relevant conventional competitor","Proposed technical team with independent validation partner; none committed","Compare AI-assisted process against a credible non-AI workflow; measure downstream price/availability only where actual pass-through can be observed.","Comparable non-AI process, quality specification, inputs and operating conditions; track conventional-product cost/price changes separately.","Validated usable output, consistency and total unit cost; retail prices/availability as separate outcomes; no automatic spending multiplier.","Proposed 3–6-month technical evaluation after feasibility; retail follow-up requires a separate agreed observation window.","Use existing feasible capability before considering infrastructure; record compute, labour, validation and scale-up cost; no budget established.","Set technical/economic success criteria before the trial; technical gain alone cannot justify a national demand claim.","india_pib_bioe3_2024;proxy_specification_20261022","author_proposal_pending_review"
"R07","D05;D06","Named policy instruments and product decisions in India and Pakistan","Proposed research owner; none assigned","Maintain a dated stage register: announcement, implementation evidence, funding/disbursement, product authorization and observable market outcome.","Original dated instrument and explicit previous stage; record evidence missing for each subsequent stage.","Verified stage changes and decision-relevant gaps; no presumed programme effect.","Proposed quarterly review; not an automated schedule.","Bound source scope and reviewer time; no monitoring infrastructure is required to draft the register.","Advance a stage only with its own supporting record; do not translate policy intent into a growth bonus.","india_pib_bioe3_2024;pakistan_cultural_halal_act_2016","author_proposal_pending_review"
note: Exact local review-candidate document, revised 27 October. Publication approval and human factual/code review remain pending.
